scope.candidate_or_finalist_judgments: Not yet performed; await frozen candidates, shortlist, external evidence, and diagnostics.
scope.independence: Independent source reading and byte verification in a separate context; not independent scientific replication or an independent model family.

method.primary_texts: Read the preserved paper extractions and surrounding method/dataset sections. Independently reran pdftotext -layout on both preserved PDFs to stdout; both outputs exactly match the preserved text bytes.
method.integrity: Recomputed SHA-256 and sizes for both PDFs, texts, HTML records, and metadata. PDF and HTML hashes match retrieval-log.json. Recursively checked the three claim manifests and four linked raw/text manifests, all referenced object hashes/sizes, and exact claim character slices. All seven manifests pass byte-integrity checks.
method.semantic_check: Checked whether each preserved quotation actually supports its claim, independently of archive hash validity.
method.location_convention: All text line references below are one-based newline-delimited lines: text.split('\n'), not splitlines(), which also treats PDF form feeds as line breaks. Page numbers are PDF page order.
method.limits: Hashes establish local byte integrity and consistency with retained provenance, not remote authorship authentication or scientific truth. No new retrieval, dataset download, model execution, or reproduction of paper experiments occurred.

sources.title: OrthoLoC: UAV 6-DoF Localization and Calibration Using Orthographic Geodata
sources.data_provenance: Section 3.1, lines 237-246: real UAV images; SfM/MVS reconstructions provide camera poses, point clouds and meshes, georeferenced with RTK or manually annotated GCPs. DOPs and DSMs are generated from these reconstructions at 5 cm/pixel. Sections 3.2-3.3 describe paired references and external geodata. Same-reconstruction pose/map agreement is not independent map-error ground truth.

sources.title: OffNadirLoc: Benchmark and Framework for Challenging UAV-to-Satellite Geo-Localization under Large Off-Nadir Views
sources.data_provenance: Section 3.1, page 3, lines 165-190: 44 geographic regions; UAV views are rendered using Google Earth's 3D engine at 70, 75, 80, 82 and 85 degrees, not collected as real drone-flight images. Lines 132-142 report region-disjoint train/test partitions and 9,736 UAV / 1,657 satellite images. These are authors' benchmark descriptions, not independently verified dataset contents.
sources.metric_scope: Page 6, lines 383-398: satellite maps partitioned into overlapping 200m x 200m patches; correctness requires the same basemap and IoU with ground-truth region above 0.14. Recall@1 is patch retrieval correctness, not metric pose accuracy or a real-world flight safety rate.

limitations.status: Empirical pattern supported; supplied quotation is defective.
limitations.manifest_integrity: Pass; the preserved slice is byte-valid but does not support the claim.

actual_support.location: Section C.7, page 29 lines 1980-1983; Figure 15 and explanation, page 30 lines 2046-2055.
actual_support.experiment_quote:
To assess algorithm robustness in real-world scenarios where perfect image retrieval cannot be
 guaranteed, we systematically reduce the covisibility ratio between query and reference images
 by cropping the reference raster.
actual_support.empirical_quote:
When the covisibility ratio drops below 20%, we observe a sharp increase in both translation and
 rotation errors.
actual_support.model_scope: GIM+DKM + AdHoP in the authors' reference-cropping experiment.

limitations.quote_defect: limitations.json and its claim manifest contain only chart tick values and whitespace (1.0, 0.1, 0.2, ...), not the low-covisibility statement. A valid archive hash does not make this a supporting quotation. Correct newline-based lines 2050-2053 contain the statement; the current location/slice discrepancy is consistent with mixing newline and form-feed-aware line counting.
limitations.causal_separation: Cropping-induced degradation is reported empirically. Spatial concentration, PnP overfitting, and an underdetermined problem are the authors' explanation, not separately isolated causes. Spatial concentration need not imply mathematical rank deficiency for every configuration.
caveats: The 20% boundary is a reported empirical regime, not a universal critical threshold.
Cropping jointly changes overlap, correspondence count, geometry, feature composition and potentially inlier quality; these require matched controls for causal attribution.
No confidence interval, precise effect size below 20%, or independent experimental replication is supplied by this audit.
Preserve the defective old claim unchanged; use this independently located support or an explicitly append-only correction before relying on its quote.
limitations.minimum_falsification_requirement: Hold query, map and matching pipeline fixed; vary support geometry while controlling match count, noise and outlier rate. Compare with spatial diversification and robust PnP/AdHoP under matched compute, and test degenerate as well as well-conditioned cases.

limitations.status: Published numeric contrast supported; causal DSM-only interpretation not established.
limitations.manifest_integrity: Pass, including a supporting table row.

actual_support.location: Section C.5 / Table 6, PDF page 28, newline-based lines 1843-1854; explanatory context lines 1872-1890.
actual_support.reported_pipeline: Baseline with AdHoP, stated immediately below Table 6.

limitations.causal_separation: Equal rounded aggregate matching error does not imply identical pointwise matches, distributions, inlier rates, or pose conditioning. The contrast is consistent with reference-geometry sensitivity, but does not establish a specific DSM bias, discontinuity, occlusion, or uncertainty mechanism.
limitations.additional_confound: Table 3, page 17, lines 1129-1134 reports different available domain populations: DOP cross-domain has 17 in-place / 496 out-place test samples; DOP+DSM has 17 / 423. Table 6 does not establish a per-query matched intervention in the inspected text. Treat cohort composition as a potential confound, not assume a controlled DSM-only change.
caveats: The matching-error equality is at published rounding precision.
The same reconstruction supplies baseline geometry and camera poses; this cannot independently validate external-map error estimates.
The paper's discussion of edge/object-boundary geometry is an explanation, not a per-failure diagnosis established here.
The provided quote includes unnecessary preceding calibration discussion but does include the exact relevant row.
limitations.minimum_falsification_requirement: Use identical queries, DOP pixels, correspondences, camera assumptions and pose solver while changing only DSM geometry. Include a strong robust/uncertainty-aware comparator, spatially correlated and discontinuous errors, and independent geometry truth or explicitly labeled synthetic truth.

limitations.status: Aggregate benchmark headroom supported; weak grounding for any particular new failure mechanism.
limitations.suitable_for_mechanism_generation: Conditional: a candidate may hypothesize a cause but must not present it as observed.

actual_support.location: Section 5.5 / Table 4, PDF page 8, newline-based lines 501-524.
actual_support.baseline_definition: DINOv2 backbone + global token + Multi-Similarity loss.

limitations.causal_separation: Residual top-1 misses do not identify their cause. The ablation supports the authors' component performance comparisons, not a diagnosis of the remaining failures. Do not equate reported repetitive-texture/occlusion explanations with a measured residual failure partition.
caveats: Rendered Google Earth viewpoints limit direct inference to real drone imagery and operational sensor errors.
27.36% is a complement of rounded aggregate Recall@1, not a raw counted failure dataset.
R@5 of 84.76% suggests potential reranking headroom in aggregate but does not identify which examples are repairable by a proposed mechanism.
Generic contextual weighting, aggregation/clustering, and grouped multi-view supervision are already components of ONLoc.
No per-query failure annotations, uncertainty intervals, or replication were examined.
limitations.minimum_falsification_requirement: Before claiming a mechanism-specific limitation, inspect held-out per-query failures under the actual patch-overlap metric. Evaluate against full ONLoc, not only its weaker baseline, with matched views, supervision and inference budget; distinguish rendering-benchmark effects from real-flight evidence.

protocol_audit.overall: Reasonable exploratory gates with important interpretation and preregistration requirements; no current basis for GO.
positive_controls: Twelve candidates, four isolated generation contexts, three shared limitations and a frozen shortlist before targeted literature expansion.
Operational mechanism, degeneracy handling, non-equivalence, likely counterexample and strong-comparator falsification are required.
Selection is explicitly not survival; absence of discovered prior art is not proof of novelty.
Separate novelty, significance, feasibility and insufficient-evidence dimensions; source-grounded arguments rather than ratings alone.
Explicit ITERATE rule and acknowledgement of unmatched prior baseline, limited model independence and unavailable enclosing billing.
Direct CLI cap 8, public-request cap 25, response-byte cap 120000000, new-primary cap 6, CPU diagnostic cap 300 seconds, no training or GPU.

concerns_and_required_interpretations.issue: Selection fairness is qualitative rather than fully operationalized.
concerns_and_required_interpretations.requirement: Before reading finalist external results, preserve all twelve candidates and the shortlist rationale, including ties and failed gates. Do not force one winner per limitation; L3's weaker causal grounding should count as uncertainty, not be silently upgraded.

concerns_and_required_interpretations.issue: The survival rule requires an affordable test, not a passed experiment.
concerns_and_required_interpretations.requirement: Label any mechanism passing that rule a defensible hypothesis only. Separately report experimentally supported mechanisms. A plausible test plan, reviewer votes, a synthetic sanity check, or no discovered counterexample cannot establish improved discovery quality.

concerns_and_required_interpretations.issue: No discriminating experimental acceptance threshold is specified in this protocol.
concerns_and_required_interpretations.requirement: Freeze each finalist's strongest comparator, data split, metric, equal-budget constraints, degeneracy treatment, and falsification threshold before its diagnostic. State when the five-minute CPU budget cannot test the substantive claim; do not lower the evidence gate to fit the budget.

concerns_and_required_interpretations.issue: Mechanism originality and portfolio distinctness must remain separate.
concerns_and_required_interpretations.requirement: Internal generated ideas are not prior publications. Overlap with an internal candidate can reduce portfolio diversity but cannot by itself refute external novelty. External novelty objections need identifiable primary sources and a technical equivalence argument.

concerns_and_required_interpretations.issue: The earlier audited 0/3 and the current twelve-candidate sampling design are unmatched.
concerns_and_required_interpretations.requirement: Do not estimate a causal or statistical improvement from survivor-count differences. A comparative discovery claim needs matched tasks, sample and search budgets, the same blinded adjudication criteria, and experimental outcomes.

concerns_and_required_interpretations.issue: The L1 quote is semantically invalid despite a valid manifest; L2 has possible cohort confounding; L3 is aggregate headroom on rendered views.
concerns_and_required_interpretations.requirement: Carry these exact caveats into shortlist review and final adjudication rather than treating source verification as unconditional causal grounding.

concerns_and_required_interpretations.issue: Review contexts and costs have bounded independence and observability.
concerns_and_required_interpretations.requirement: Record all public attempts, bytes, primary additions and direct CLI receipts across the campaign. Do not count this enclosing agent's unavailable billing as zero or confuse raw review votes with validated survival.
